description: We are "Spatium IV", a team of friends from Salta, Argentina, passionate about robotics, programming, AI, and innovation. We have worked together at the CopaBot, developing our teamwork and problem-solving skills. Now we're taking on the NASA Space Apps Challenge and aiming for RoboLiga 2027. We value creativity, curiosity, collaboration, and skills in coding, design, research, and communication. Our goal is to learn, innovate, and grow together!
